name: Random events: the Quiz Master, his invitation, the studio and the odd-one-out window

steps.comment: Off first, so the timer can't send a second event mid-script.
The studio: look that the player sits in the black chair under a spotlight, facing the Quiz Master.
steps.speaker: Quiz Master

steps.comment: The question: look that the chatbox says Pick the odd one out. over three spinning items, two of one kind and one of another, each with Select. Answering, the prizes and the mystery box are the headless test's part.

The question window takes the chatbox, so no command can be typed until it is answered (nightly 2026-11-28 stalled on ::tele here). A logout leaves the studio: the relog is back on the tile the invitation was taken from.
